derivation: Derived from each rule's own description in scanner.RULES, the same standard applied to third-party tools. Written down before any scanner was run against the corpus, then corrected once when the first version guessed semantic rule ids the scanner never emits; the correction came from the rule descriptions, not from what fired. Full account in PROTOCOL.md.
note: This file existed for other people's scanners before it existed for ours, which meant our own tool was scored by hand and was not on the clock. Fixed 2026-08-31.
structural_gaps: Three corpus-1 classes had no corresponding rule in v1 and were counted as misses. SOL-017, SOL-018 and SOL-019 were added in v2 to cover them; SOL-017 and SOL-018 still never fire, so those classes remain misses for a different reason. Two corpus-2 classes, instruction-introspection and arithmetic-rounding-drain, have no rule at all and are recorded as no-rule rather than as failures.
